items.Sentence: The WWTP consists of an unlined aerated stabilization pond and a LAA. The pond provides both wastewater treatment and storage with an approximate capacity of 12.2 acre-feet based on two feet of free board. Disposal of wastewater is accomplished by a combination of percolation and evaporation in the pond.
Prior to application on the LAA, pond supernatant is first pumped through an automatic self-backwashing strainer before being applied to the LAA.
The LAA includes five acres of sprayfield and five acres of buffer area. The LAA has not been used in recent years.
When required these solids are removed from the pond and transported to the La Contenta Wastewater Treatment Facility for additional treatment, dewatering, and disposal.
